future_operator_plan.description: Freeze source, artifact manifest, acceptance session and runtime closure; rerun the offline validator before any board change.
Only after an approved maintenance window, transfer the verified versioned artifact and overlay roots, record their SHA-256 values, and preserve the prior roots for rollback.
Recheck real board identity, package closure, model and vocabulary hashes, connected RGB-D/TF/map inputs and resource headroom before launching the product graph.
Collect the 1800-second board evidence with no actuator commands, copy raw evidence back to the frozen acceptance worktree, then run the session-bound offline validator.

future_operator_sequence: Stop only the approved product graph and retain its logs; do not issue actuator commands.
Restore the recorded prior versioned artifact and overlay roots, then verify their manifest hashes before reuse.
If identity, package closure, model hash or resource gates disagree, remain G0/G1 read-only and mark formal acceptance blocked.
